arrival.speaker: elira
arrival.text: Caelan. Come in—there’s room, if you can get past my preparations.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: I’ve brought bread and lamp oil from Serene.

arrival.speaker: elira
arrival.text: Oh, good. I was trying to remember whether I had enough oil left.

arrival.speaker: elira
arrival.text: For tomorrow, and for seeing what I’m doing tonight. I keep finding one more thing that needs attention.

arrival.speaker: elira
arrival.text: My lantern, once I get it down. I put it on that shelf to keep it safe. Now I can’t reach it safely myself.

arrival.speaker: elira
arrival.text: Would you? The stool’s underneath. Bring it over to the table when you’ve got it.

arrival.speaker: elira
arrival.text: It should be, but take it by the bottom as well. I’d rather you didn’t find out halfway down.

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: There. Now I can see what needs cleaning.

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: It’s lasted well. My husband was very particular about putting it away properly. I used to think he made a performance of it.

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: I’ll carry it for him again tomorrow.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: Will you come up for the singing?

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: Of course. Someone has to make up for the noise he used to make.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: *a small smile* Was he that bad?

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: Dreadful. And quite pleased with himself. I’d lose my place because I was trying not to laugh.

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: Sometimes I still expect to hear him when everyone starts.

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: *after a moment* I do want to come, Caelan.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: I know. I wasn’t sure what to say.

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: You don’t have to say anything. You’ve brought my lantern down. Stay a minute while I have a look at it.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: Shall I tell Serene you’ll bring it yourself?

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: Yes, please. And thank her for the bread and oil.

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: I’ll see you tomorrow. Come and find me when you’ve finished helping everyone else.

reminder.speaker: elira
reminder.text: The stool’s under the shelf. Support the bottom when you lift it.

carrying.speaker: elira
carrying.text: Here on the table, please. Leave me enough room beside it to work.

after.speaker: elira
after.text: I’ve got everything I need now. I’ll see you tomorrow.
